response.sql:
WITH team_stats AS (
  SELECT
    team_id,
    CAST(SUM(w) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(DISTINCT year) AS avg_wins,
    AVG(CAST(g - l AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(CAST(l AS FLOAT), 0)) AS avg_gl_ratio
  FROM manager_half
  GROUP BY team_id
),
mean_avg_wins AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_wins
  FROM team_stats
),
filtered_teams AS (
  SELECT
    ts.team_id,
    ts.avg_wins,
    ts.avg_gl_ratio,
    ts.avg_wins - maw.mean_wins AS gap
  FROM team_stats ts
  CROSS JOIN mean_avg_wins maw
  WHERE ts.avg_wins > maw.mean_wins
)
SELECT
  team_id,
  avg_wins,
  avg_gl_ratio,
  gap
FROM filtered_teams
ORDER BY CASE WHEN gap IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, gap DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Rows where losses (l) = 0 produce an undefined ratio (g − l) / l. These are converted to NULL using NULLIF and skipped by AVG, interpreting 'ignoring missing values' as the standard SQL behavior of AVG on NULL values.
